title: 第013章 家族六法尽数掌控第014章 炼气三层父子对战
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 第013章家族六法，尽数掌控！
三天后，李定元入土为安，入宗祠、立牌位。
此事告一段落。
回到家中，娘亲陈秀云面露哀伤：“元儿，这些天，你冬儿婶子哭晕三次。”
“青青又还小，唉！”
李定舟说道：“这次狩猎，要不是运气好，家族必受重创。”
“要不是我恰好炼气、炼体同时突破，根本做不到独自牵制一头战力堪比炼气五层的妖兽。”
“要不是族长给了我们十张一阶中品符纸，能对一阶中期灵兽造成伤害，死伤会更加惨重。”
李定舟心有余悸道：“这次能安全回来，运气成分很大。”
“不过，收获也不错。”
李定舟盘算道：“狩猎队，除了狩猎妖兽外，还有采摘灵植的工作。”
“此次狩猎，外出月余，一共采摘一阶灵植十三株。
其中有两株灵植的品级达到一阶中品。”
“大长老初步估算，灵植价值，不低于五十块灵石。”
李定舟补充道：“此外，猎杀一阶初期灵兽7头。
一阶中期灵兽4头。
折算下来后，价值百来块灵石。”
“狩猎队此行的收获，都快赶上往年大半年的狩猎收益了。”
说罢，李定舟掏出五块灵石，说道：“元儿，此次狩猎，为父的贡献仅次于二长老，获得五块灵石。”
“你都拿去吧。”
李定舟举杯喝茶，一边说道：“早日突破炼气一层圆满，尽快踏入炼气二层。”
李青元笑了笑，运转《大椿功》，炼气二层气息显露，说道：“爹，我已经是炼气二层了。”
李定舟噗的一声，茶水喷吐，咳嗽起来：“咳咳咳，炼气二层？”
“你达到炼气二层了！
娘亲陈秀云也是一脸惊愕，难以置信道：“元儿，你已经是炼气二层了。”
“可是，你修炼至今，也才半年而已啊。”
李定舟一扫阴霾，朗声笑道：“哈哈哈，好，不愧是我儿子，不愧是我李氏仙族的麒麟子。”
“短短半年，炼气二层，我儿果然是个天才。”
李定舟面色严肃道：“云妹，关于元儿修为之事，谁也不能说，知道吗？”
陈秀云瞪了他一眼，说道：“我又不笨，当然知道要保密。”
“元儿～”
李定舟问道：“你修为之事，还有谁知道？”
李青元说道：“孩儿七天前突破的，目前只有爹娘，以及族长爷爷、大长老爷爷知道。”
“孩儿估计，二长老爷爷现在也知道了。”
李定舟点头，说道：“以后你每次突破，都要让族长、大长老、二长老知道。
他们三位是我李氏一族高层。”
“你越天才，他们越重视，越会倾尽资源栽培你。”
李青元点头：“爹，孩子懂。”
“孩儿下去修炼了。”
李青元拿走五块灵石，离开家中，直奔自己的独居小院。
小院中，李青元将5块灵石收入【玄牝空间】，经过复制后，资源翻倍，成为10块灵石。

Chapter 013: Control all six family methods!
Three days later, Li Dingyuan was laid to rest, entered the ancestral hall and set up a memorial tablet.
The matter came to an end.
Back home, her mother, Chen Xiuyun, looked sad: "Yuan'er, your Aunt Dong'er has fainted from crying three times in the past few days."
"Qingqing is still young, alas!"
Li Dingzhou said: "If it weren't for good luck during this hunting, the family would have suffered heavy losses."
"If I hadn't happened to be refining Qi and refining my body at the same time to break through, I wouldn't have been able to contain a monster with combat power comparable to the fifth level of Qi Refining alone."
"If the clan leader hadn't given us ten first-level mid-grade talismans, which can cause damage to mid-level first-order spiritual beasts, the casualties would have been even more severe."
Li Dingzhou said with lingering fear: "It's a lot of luck that I can come back safely this time."
"However, the harvest is not bad."
Li Dingzhou calculated: "In addition to hunting monsters, the hunting team also has the job of picking spiritual plants."
“In this hunting, I went out for more than a month and picked a total of thirteen first-order spiritual plants.
Among them, two spiritual plants reached the first-level mid-grade level. "
"The Great Elder initially estimates that the value of the spiritual plant is no less than fifty spiritual stones."
Li Dingzhou added: "In addition, we hunted 7 first-order early stage spiritual beasts.
There are 4 mid-level first-level spiritual beasts.
After conversion, it is worth hundreds of spiritual stones. "
"The hunting team's harvest from this trip has almost caught up with the hunting income of most of the previous years."
After that, Li Dingzhou took out five spiritual stones and said: "Yuan'er, in this hunting, my father's contribution is second only to the second elder, and I got five spiritual stones."
"Take them all."
Li Dingzhou raised his cup to drink tea and said: "Break through the first level of Qi Refining as soon as possible, and step into the second level of Qi Refining as soon as possible."
Li Qingyuan smiled and started to run the "Dachun Gong". The aura of the second level of Qi Refining was revealed, and he said: "Dad, I am already at the second level of Qi Refining."
"Pfft~"
Li Dingzhou spit out the tea and coughed: "Ahem, cough, cough, second level of Qi refining?"
"You have reached the second level of Qi Refining!
? "
My mother, Chen Xiuyun, was also shocked and said in disbelief: "Yuan'er, you are already at the second level of Qi Refining."
"But, you have only been practicing for half a year."
Li Dingzhou swept away the gloom and laughed loudly: "Hahaha, okay, he is worthy of being my son, and worthy of being the unicorn son of my Li Clan's Immortal Clan."
"In just six months, I have reached the second level of Qi Refining. My son is indeed a genius."
Li Dingzhou said with a serious face: "Mei Yun, no one can say anything about Yuan'er's cultivation, do you understand?"
Chen Xiuyun glared at him and said, "I'm not stupid, of course I know to keep it a secret."
"Yuan'er~"
Li Dingzhou asked: "Who else knows about your cultivation?"
Li Qingyuan said: "The child's breakthrough seven days ago is currently only known to the parents, the patriarch, and the great elder."
"I guess the second elder grandpa also knows about it now."
Li Dingzhou nodded and said: "Every time you make a breakthrough in the future, you must let the clan leader, first elder, and second elder know about it.
The three of them are the top leaders of my Li family. "
"The more talented you are, the more they value you and the more they will devote their resources to cultivating you."
Li Qingyuan nodded: "Dad, the child understands."
"My child has gone down to practice."
Li Qingyuan took away five spiritual stones, left home, and went straight to his small courtyard where he lived alone.
In the small courtyard, Li Qingyuan put 5 spiritual stones into the [Xuanfei Space]. After copying, the resources doubled and became 10 spiritual stones.
